description: This file contains middleware classes for logging, rate limiting, access control, and error handling within the superset MCP service. It includes functions for sanitizing errors and parameters, and classes implementing middleware logic for request/response processing, security, and permissions.

classes.name: LoggingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for logging MCP messages and tool calls, including error sanitization and context extraction.

classes.name: PrivateToolMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware to block access to tools tagged as 'private'.

classes.name: GlobalErrorHandlerMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for global error handling, logging, and converting exceptions into ToolError responses.

classes.name: RateLimiterProtocol
classes.description: Protocol interface for rate limiter implementations.

classes.name: InMemoryRateLimiter
classes.description: In-memory implementation of rate limiting for development environments.

classes.name: RedisRateLimiter
classes.description: Redis-backed implementation of rate limiting for production environments.

classes.name: RateLimitMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware enforcing sliding window rate limits per user, IP, and tool.

classes.name: FieldPermissionsMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware applying field-level permissions to filter sensitive data based on user permissions.

methods.name: _sanitize_error_for_logging
methods.description: Sanitizes error messages to prevent information disclosure and ReDoS attacks.

methods.name: _extract_context_info
methods.description: Extracts agent_id, user_id, and entity IDs from request context.

methods.name: on_call_tool
methods.description: Logs and tracks execution time of tool calls.

methods.name: on_call_tool
methods.description: Blocks access to private tools based on tags.

methods.name: on_message
methods.description: Handles errors during message processing, providing consistent error responses.

methods.name: _handle_error
methods.description: Handles different exception types, logs errors, and raises appropriate ToolError responses.

methods.name: is_rate_limited
methods.description: Checks if a key exceeds rate limit within a time window.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes old entries to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: create_rate_limiter
methods.description: Factory function selecting Redis or in-memory rate limiter based on environment.

methods.name: on_call_tool
methods.description: Enforces rate limits before allowing tool execution.

methods.name: on_call_tool
methods.description: Applies field-level permissions to filter response data based on user permissions.
